subject: Developer Portal Integration + Seat Expansion — next steps and SOW
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@corefit.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: platform@corefit.io
Date: 2027-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Scaling to additional teams + developer portal integration

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs were impressed by the latency numbers. We're ready to move from a two-team pilot to a broader rollout across Product, Analytics, and Search (roughly 12 new apps). A few asks up front: 

- We'd like a separate API key per team for quota tracking and revocation.
- Anticipated steady-state consumption is ~6M tokens/day, with bursts to ~12M, so we need guidance on committed capacity vs burst.
- We want the Redwood integration surfaced in our developer portal (single-click onboarding for internal teams) — PS support likely required.
- Pricing: the execs prefer a single amendment rather than multiple POs; can we get an annual commitment quote and draft amendment?

Attached is our current usage export and a short document outlining the teams/apps. Can we get an initial SOW and a timeline for activation?

Best,
Elena Morales
CTO, CoreFit

Attachments: corefit_usage_q2.csv (csv), corefit_team_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@corefit.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling to additional teams + developer portal integration

Hi Elena — really great to see the pilot results translate into clear demand.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:

1) Commercial: I'll get you an annual amendment that folds the additional teams into one committed contract. I suggest two capacity tiers for the amendment (6M/day steady + 12M/day burst as a premium). Ben, please draft pricing options and PS estimate.

2) Security & keys: We can provision per-team API keys scoped to projects and set per-key quotas and rotation policies. Karthik, can you confirm the provisioning lead time for 12 keys and whether we should stagger the rollout?

3) Developer portal: Our Solutions team can produce a lightweight integration (widget + onboarding doc). Laura, estimate PS hours for a one-week sprint to deliver the widget, docs, and two dev office hours.

4) Timeline: target pilot expansion kickoff week of Aug 16, with full activation by Sep 3 if procurement moves quickly.

I'll attach a draft SOW and an amendment template for your legal. Please loop in procurement if you'd like a consolidated PO flow.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the price options this afternoon.

Warmly,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: PS_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), redwood_amendment_draft.docx (docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@corefit.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling to additional teams + developer portal integration

Hi all — copied a quick commercial + technical note below.

Commercial options (high level):
- Option A: Annual committed throughput for 6M tokens/day + 2x burst capacity available at up to 12M/day. Unit pricing: $0.0012/token for committed, $0.0018/token for burst. Estimated annual spend: $2.6M.
- Option B: Tiered commit — 3M/day commit + pay-as-you-go for the remainder (lower upfront). Estimated annual spend: $1.9M.

I can produce a full line-item quote + amendment tonight.

Technical notes (for the rollout):
- Per-team keys: we can script creation and tagging; provisioning for 12 keys + metadata should be done in a single business day once we have the project IDs.
- Quota enforcement: recommend soft-limits with alerts for the first month, then hard limits after stabilization.
- Developer portal widget: small JS snippet to create API key request flow + automated email to the team owner; PS effort: 18 hours dev + 6 hours QA + 4 hours doc + 4 hours office hours = 32 hours.

Questions: Elena, do you want the widget to create keys automatically (recommended) or to raise a ticket for manual approval?

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

--

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@corefit.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: platform@corefit.io, procurement@corefit.io
Date: 2027-08-03T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling to additional teams + developer portal integration

Hi Naomi / Ben — thanks, these options look reasonable. A couple clarifications: 

- We'll go with automatic key creation through the widget, but we'd like a short approval flow for teams that request >500k tokens/day.
- Procurement prefers Option A if you can offer a small implementation credit against PS (helps move the PO faster).
- For compliance: we'll need the SOW to list SOC2 evidence we can request (audit logs, token retention policy).

If you can send an amended quote with the implementation credit and a redlined amendment we can share with Legal, procurement will try to get the PO signed in the first week of Sep.

Thanks — looping in procurement for timelines.

—Elena

Attachments: n/a

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@corefit.io>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling to additional teams + developer portal integration

Hi Elena — great to see momentum. From a delivery standpoint, here's a suggested rollout plan that keeps risk low: 

Week 1 (Aug 16): Provision 4 pilot keys (Product, Search, Analytics, Internal Tools). Enable soft quotas + alerting.
Week 2 (Aug 23): Ship dev portal widget to internal sandbox; run two internal office hours for integrators.
Week 3 (Aug 30): Expand to remaining teams (8 keys) with staggered activation across the week.
Week 4 (Sep 6): Post-activation monitoring, hard quota enforcement for teams that remained stable.

PS SOW estimate aligns with Ben's 32 hours for the widget + 16 hours for integration support and staging work (total 48 hours). We can apply a $6k implementation credit against the PS line if you sign the annual Option A.

I'll update the SOW with compliance evidence checklist and a short runbook for quota incidents. Naomi — once you confirm pricing I'll send the redlined amendment and SOW for Elena's legal.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
